content_chunks.title: Personal Background and Overview
content_chunks.content: My name is Tsai Chun Lin. I graduated from Victoria University with a Master of Applied Information Technology with a GPA of 6.25. I am passionate about frontend and full-stack development and want to build engaging web applications. I have a strong foundation in JavaScript, Python, and PHP, with experience in modern web development practices.

content_chunks.title: Career Objectives and Goals
content_chunks.content: I aim to obtain a position as a Frontend or Full-Stack Developer to apply my technical skills, creativity, and problem-solving skills to build efficient web applications and contribute to a dynamic team. Short-term goals include gaining commercial experience with React.js and Node.js. Long-term, I want to progress to senior developer or technical lead roles.

content_chunks.title: Salary and Location Preferences
content_chunks.content: Expected salary range: $60,000 - $65,000 AUD annually for graduate or junior developer roles. Open to Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane locations. Willing to relocate within Australia. Available for hybrid work arrangements. Can start immediately or with 2 weeks notice. Authorized to work in Australia.

content_chunks.title: Education Background and Academic Achievements
content_chunks.content: Master of Applied Information Technology, Victoria University (2024-2025), GPA: 6.25. Coursework: Advanced Web Development, Database Systems, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity. Previously, Master of Information Systems & Advertising, University of Queensland (2021-2023), GPA: 5.37. Relevant projects included web application development, database design, and system analysis.

content_chunks.title: Professional Work Experience
content_chunks.content: Technical Support Intern at Ben Cutains (Jan 2025 - Apr 2025): Organized website content, managed images via WordPress, assisted with sales tasks. Implemented systematic content organization, optimized image formats for web performance, created content guidelines for team. Currently Part-time Barista at Kitchen Montague: Developed customer service skills, time management under pressure, team collaboration in fast-paced environment.

content_chunks.title: Technical Skills and Programming Experience
content_chunks.content: Programming Languages: Python (1 year, intermediate) - data analysis, automation scripts; JavaScript (1 year, intermediate) - DOM manipulation, async programming; PHP (6 months, beginner-intermediate) - server-side development, MySQL integration. Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, responsive design, cross-browser compatibility. Database: MySQL - design, queries, optimization. Version Control: Git/GitHub - branching, merging, collaborative development. Familiar with: Agile methodologies, testing fundamentals, documentation practices.

content_chunks.title: Book 2 Drive Project - Capstone Leadership Experience
content_chunks.content: University capstone project requiring development of a functional driving lesson booking application for 3-person team. I led frontend development, designed user interface, implemented booking system with database integration. Designed responsive UI using HTML, CSS, JavaScript; implemented user authentication system; created MySQL database with proper ERD; developed booking workflow with validation; collaborated using Git for version control. Successfully delivered fully functional web application on time; implemented features exceeded initial requirements by 20%; gained experience in full-stack development and team leadership.

content_chunks.title: Additional Development Projects
content_chunks.content: News Homepage Project: Created modern, mobile-first news portal using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap; implemented grid system; optimized for multiple screen sizes; used semantic HTML for accessibility. Achieved 95+ PageSpeed score, fully responsive across devices. Multi-Step Form Project: Built multi-step form with validation and progress tracking using JavaScript form validation, progress indicators, local storage for data persistence. Created smooth user experience with 0 validation errors in testing.

content_chunks.title: Soft Skills and Professional Capabilities
content_chunks.content: Problem Solving: During Book 2 Drive project, identified and resolved database connection issues that were blocking team progress; implemented alternative authentication approach when initial method failed. Communication: Led weekly team meetings for university project; presented technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders; documented code and processes for team knowledge sharing. Time Management: Successfully balanced full-time studies, part-time work, and project deadlines; delivered all assignments on time while maintaining 6.25 GPA. Teamwork: Collaborated effectively in 3-person development team; mentored team members on Git workflow; resolved merge conflicts and maintained code quality standards.

content_chunks.title: Detailed Career Goals and Learning Path
content_chunks.content: Short-term (6-12 months): Secure junior to mid-level frontend or full-stack developer position; gain commercial experience with React.js and Node.js; contribute to real-world applications that impact users. Medium-term (1-3 years): Develop expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks; take on increasing technical responsibilities; mentor junior developers; contribute to architectural decisions. Long-term (3-5 years): Progress to senior developer or technical lead role; specialize in frontend architecture or full-stack solutions; contribute to open source projects; potentially pursue team leadership opportunities. Continuous learning focus: Advanced React patterns, TypeScript, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), DevOps practices, UX/UI design principles.

content_chunks.title: Professional Strengths and Areas for Growth
content_chunks.content: Strengths: Strong foundation in multiple programming languages, proven ability to learn new technologies quickly, experience working in team environments, problem-solving mindset, attention to detail in code quality. Areas for growth: Limited commercial experience, seeking opportunities to work with larger codebases, interested in learning industry best practices, want to gain experience with CI/CD and deployment processes.

content_chunks.title: Motivation for Web Development Career
content_chunks.content: I enjoy the creative problem-solving aspect, satisfaction of building functional applications, interested in technology's impact on user experience, motivated by continuous learning opportunities in the field. Web development combines technical challenges with creative expression, allowing me to build solutions that directly impact users' daily lives.

content_chunks.title: Database Experience and Expertise
content_chunks.content: Yes, I have experience with MySQL including database design, queries, and optimization. During my Book 2 Drive project, I created a MySQL database with proper ERD and implemented user authentication systems. My coursework also covered Database Systems as part of my Master's degree. I understand relational database concepts, normalization, and performance optimization techniques.

content_chunks.title: Problem-Solving Methodology and Examples
content_chunks.content: I approach problems systematically by first understanding the requirements, breaking down complex issues into smaller components, researching solutions, and implementing step-by-step fixes. During the Book 2 Drive project, I identified and resolved database connection issues that were blocking team progress and implemented alternative authentication approaches when initial methods failed. I believe in thorough testing and documentation throughout the problem-solving process.
